display.purpose: Hub headline and section headings only; never buttons, labels, or diagram text.

body.purpose: All working interface copy, panels, forms, console prompts.

title.purpose: Card names, project title, panel headings.

mono.purpose: Generated code, console output, and numeric diagram data only.

shadows.name: rest
shadows.purpose: Cards, buttons, and controls at rest.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: Hovered cards and the floating run toolbar.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Dialogs, drawers, and floating toolbars above the work area.

motion.purpose: Ambient loops such as skeleton shimmer.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Committed action such as creating a project or starting a run.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; height: 38px; padding: 0 15px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9px; background: var(--accent, #b53d28); color: var(--accent-contrast, #fffaf6); font-family: var(--font-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; box-shadow: 0 10px 22px -12px rgb(181 61 40 / 75%); transition: background 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #9e3522; box-shadow: 0 14px 28px -12px rgb(181 61 40 / 70%); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(0.995); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(23 32 43 / 7%); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #b53d28); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Neutral action beside a primary one: import, export, cancel.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; height: 38px; padding: 0 15px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, #cdc5b7); border-radius: 9px; background: var(--surface, #fffdf9); color: var(--text, #17202b); font-family: var(--font-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(23 32 43 / 7%); transition: background 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn:hover { background: var(--surface-2, #f7f3ec); box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgb(23 32 43 / 6%), 0 14px 32px -14px rgb(23 32 43 / 24%); } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(0.995); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #b53d28); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Expression and value inputs in the inspector; warm fill flips to paper on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; font-family: var(--font-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-field > span { color: var(--text, #17202b); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-field input { height: 36px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #e2dcd1); border-radius: 9px; background: var(--surface-2, #f7f3ec); color: var(--text, #17202b); font: inherit; font-size: 13px; outline: none; transition: border-color 140ms ease, box-shadow 140ms ease, background 140ms ease; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong, #cdc5b7); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { background: var(--surface, #fffdf9); border-color: var(--accent, #b53d28); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(181 61 40 / 16%); outline: none; }

components.name: Navigation Rail Item
components.description: Ink rail entry; current route gets a vermilion-tinted plaque and keeps its icon lit.
components.html: ProyekEditor
components.css: .ds-rail { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; width: 248px; padding: 14px; background: var(--rail, #17202b); font-family: var(--font-ui, sans-serif); border-radius: 12px; } .ds-rail-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 11px; padding: 9px 10px; border-radius: 10px; color: var(--rail-muted, #a2adb9); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 550; text-decoration: none; transition: background 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-rail-item:hover { background: var(--rail-raised, #202b38); color: var(--rail-text, #f6f2ea); } .ds-rail-item.is-current { background: rgb(181 61 40 / 17%); color: var(--rail-text, #f6f2ea); } .ds-rail-item.is-current svg { color: var(--accent, #b53d28); } .ds-rail-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #b53d28); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Compact storage or state label under the hub headline.
components.html: Lokal, tanpa akun
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 5px 9px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #e2dcd1); border-radius: 99px; background: var(--surface, #fffdf9); color: var(--text-muted, #5e6874); font-family: var(--font-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-chip svg { color: var(--success, #0a7f6a); }

components.name: Project Card
components.description: Project tile with a route-map preview; lifts on hover and reveals its open affordance.
components.html:
Halo Dunia

24 Nov, 18.20 · 3 node
components.css: .ds-card { width: 252px; padding: 12px 12px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #e2dcd1); border-radius: 18px; background: var(--surface, #fffdf9); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(23 32 43 / 7%); font-family: var(--font-ui, sans-serif); transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 200ms ease; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); border-color: rgb(181 61 40 / 38%); box-shadow: 0 30px 70px -24px rgb(23 32 43 / 38%), 0 8px 24px -12px rgb(23 32 43 / 18%); } .ds-card-preview { height: 132px; margin-bottom: 12px; border-radius: 12px; background: radial-gradient(140px 100px at 80% 10%, rgb(181 61 40 / 9%), transparent 70%), var(--surface-2, #f7f3ec); overflow: hidden; } .ds-card-preview svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; } .ds-card-preview path { fill: none; stroke: var(--border-strong, #cdc5b7); stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; transition: stroke 220ms ease; } .ds-card:hover .ds-card-preview path { stroke: rgb(181 61 40 / 55%); } .ds-card-preview circle { fill: var(--surface, #fffdf9); stroke: var(--border-strong, #cdc5b7); stroke-width: 2; } .ds-card-preview circle:first-of-type { fill: var(--success, #0a7f6a); stroke: var(--success, #0a7f6a); } .ds-card-preview circle:nth-of-type(3) { fill: var(--accent, #b53d28); stroke: var(--accent, #b53d28); } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0 0 3px; padding: 0 2px; color: var(--text, #17202b); font-size: 14.5px; font-weight: 620; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; padding: 0 2px; color: var(--text-muted, #5e6874); font-size: 11.5px; }

components.name: Inspector Tab
components.description: Segmented tab in the inspector header; active state is a raised paper plaque, not an underline.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 2px; padding: 6px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, #e2dcd1); background: var(--surface-2, #f7f3ec); font-family: var(--font-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-tab { padding: 6px 2px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--text-muted, #5e6874); font: inherit; font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background 140ms ease, color 140ms ease; } .ds-tab:hover { background: var(--surface, #fffdf9); color: var(--text, #17202b); } .ds-tab.is-active { background: var(--surface, #fffdf9); color: var(--accent, #b53d28); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(23 32 43 / 7%); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #b53d28); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Live Route Connector
components.description: Signature component. Neutral smooth-step route at rest; when its source station is active it turns vermilion, gains a dash pulse, and a dot travels the path.
components.html: <svg class="ds-edge" viewBox="0 0 220 150" width="220" height="150"><path class="ds-edge-path" d="M110 20v50a12 12 0 0 0 12 12h-24"/><path class="ds-edge-pulse" pathLength="1" d="M110 20v50a12 12 0 0 0 12 12h-24"/><circle class="ds-edge-dot" r="3.4"><animateMotion dur="1.1s" repeatCount="indefinite" path="M110 20v50a12 12 0 0 0 12 12h-24"/></circle></svg>
components.css: .ds-edge { overflow: visible; } .ds-edge-path { fill: none; stroke: var(--border-strong, #cdc5b7); stroke-width: 1.7; stroke-linecap: round; transition: stroke 160ms ease, stroke-width 160ms ease; } .ds-edge:hover .ds-edge-path { stroke: var(--accent, #b53d28); stroke-width: 2.4; stroke-dasharray: 6 5; animation: ds-edge-dash 0.55s linear infinite; } .ds-edge-pulse { fill: none; stroke: var(--accent, #b53d28); stroke-width: 2.6; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-dasharray: 0.16 0.84; opacity: 0.9; animation: ds-edge-flow 1.1s linear infinite; } .ds-edge-dot { fill: var(--accent, #b53d28); stroke: var(--surface, #fffdf9); stroke-width: 2; } @keyframes ds-edge-flow { to { stroke-dashoffset: -1; } } @keyframes ds-edge-dash { to { stroke-dashoffset: -11; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-edge-dot { display: none; } .ds-edge-pulse { animation: none; } .ds-edge:hover .ds-edge-path { stroke-dasharray: none; animation: none; } }

narrative.overview: MarcoFlow looks like a campus route map read in the morning: warm paper, deep ink, and a single vermilion line telling you where you are going. The interface is a working tool first, so navigation, panels, tabs, and forms stay familiar. The world enters through colour, type, density, and one live gesture: when a program runs, the active station and its connector pulse like a route being travelled.
keyCharacteristics: Warm porcelain ground with a deep ink sidebar.
One vermilion accent reserved for action, selection, and the live route.
Line colours (cobalt, teal, amber) carry diagram meaning, never decoration.
Compact product density with generous grouping.
Motion explains state: route pulse, panel slide, drag lift, modal rise.

rules.name: The One Live Line Rule
rules.body: Only the active path and its outgoing connector wear vermilion. Everything else stays neutral so the run state is unmistakable.

rules.name: The No-Mono-UI Rule
rules.body: Monospace appears only inside code, console output, and numeric data; labels and buttons never wear it as a costume.

rules.name: The Lift-On-Intent Rule
rules.body: Surfaces rest flat-ish and lift only when the visitor points at them or an overlay opens.

dos: Do keep vermilion for the active action or the active route only.
Do use warm paper and ink navy as the base contrast before adding a line colour.
Do keep node silhouettes and control positions standard for a flowchart tool.
Do animate state changes in 150-300ms with cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1).
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion: keep colour/opacity feedback, remove travel.
donts: Don't use monospace for UI labels, buttons, or marketing copy.
Don't use glass/blur as decoration; blur only separates a modal from the page.
Don't add a second accent for decoration or gradients inside text.
Don't put a coloured left border on cards, alerts, or list items.
Don't animate layout-driving properties; use transforms, opacity, and grid/flex reveal.
